# Builder Facts: Regional and Luxury Builders (Clark County, Nevada)

**Researcher:** Builder Facts Researcher, Regional and Luxury Builders
**Verification date for every citation in this file:** 2026-07-25
**Scope:** Clark County, Nevada only. Pahrump, Mesquite, and Boulder City rows were stripped and are logged at the bottom.
**Citation rule:** every external fact carries `[source: URL | verified: 2026-07-25]`. Anything not verified is the literal string `NOT FOUND`.

**How to read this file.** These are smaller and more local builders than the national volume builders. Several publish almost nothing about warranty terms, lender relationships, or build timelines. That absence is the finding. Do not fill those gaps with assumptions. Nevada builders commonly use a 1 year / 2 year / 10 year warranty split, but only one builder in this group publishes the actual document, so only that one is reported that way.

---

## 1. Toll Brothers

**builder**
Toll Brothers, Inc. Sells in Clark County under the Toll Brothers name and also operates StoryBook Homes as a Nevada division (see Section 4). [source: https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/Las-Vegas-NV | verified: 2026-07-25]

**warranty**
Toll Brothers publishes an actual warranty document, titled "Warranty-ALL (New Home Limited Warranty)," revision date 02/16/2022T, 49 pages. It has three tiers, all starting on the closing date of the original purchase: [source: https://cdn.tollbrothers.com/pdfs/warranty_sc_toll.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **One year, materials and workmanship.** Covers certain materials and workmanship as set out in the document's Standards of Performance. [source: https://cdn.tollbrothers.com/pdfs/warranty_sc_toll.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]
- **Two years, systems.** Covers "the workability of certain plumbing, electrical, heating, ventilating, air conditioning, and other mechanical systems as defined in the Standards of Performance." [source: https://cdn.tollbrothers.com/pdfs/warranty_sc_toll.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]
- **Ten years, structural.** Covers defined structural elements. The document adds a limit that matters a great deal to a buyer: "No action will be required by Toll Brothers unless the structural element is incapable of performing its load-bearing function such that the Home is unsafe." It also states that structural elements do not include exterior wall cladding, which it lists as possibly including brick, stucco, or other siding materials. [source: https://cdn.tollbrothers.com/pdfs/warranty_sc_toll.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]

Other published terms in the same document worth knowing:

- If a component is not specifically named in the Standards of Performance, it is not warranted. [source: https://cdn.tollbrothers.com/pdfs/warranty_sc_toll.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]
- A warranty request must be in writing, submitted online at www.mytollhome.com or by certified mail. The document states that notice given orally, by phone, or by email does not count as a warranty request. [source: https://cdn.tollbrothers.com/pdfs/warranty_sc_toll.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]
- The buyer must notify Toll Brothers "as soon as possible and in no event later than 30 days after you become or should have become aware" of the problem, and a request received more than 30 days after the applicable one, two, or ten year period expires creates no obligation. [source: https://cdn.tollbrothers.com/pdfs/warranty_sc_toll.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]
- The document disclaims implied warranties, including habitability and workmanlike construction, to the extent allowed by law. [source: https://cdn.tollbrothers.com/pdfs/warranty_sc_toll.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]
- All disputes go to mandatory mediation and then binding arbitration. The document states that both parties waive the right to a court proceeding and a jury trial. [source: https://cdn.tollbrothers.com/pdfs/warranty_sc_toll.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]
- **Nevada applicability check.** The document names state-specific provisions for California, Colorado, Maryland, Minnesota, New York, Texas, and Virginia, and says it does not apply in New Jersey, Prince George's County MD, or New Castle County DE. Nevada is in neither list, so the base terms above are the published terms for a Nevada home. Confirm the version handed to the buyer at contract, because the posted revision is dated 2022. [source: https://cdn.tollbrothers.com/pdfs/warranty_sc_toll.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]

**in_house_lender**
Toll Brothers Mortgage Company, NMLS #18154, described on its own site as "a subsidiary of Toll Brothers, Inc." [source: https://www.tollbrothersmortgage.com/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

**Yes, the advertised incentive is conditioned on using it.** The Las Vegas page advertises a 3.99% (6.04% APR) first-year rate on a 30 year fixed with a 2/1 buydown. The attached disclaimer states: "Financing provided by Toll Brothers Mortgage Company: NMLS #18154 ... Buyer must complete a Rate Lock Agreement with Toll Brothers Mortgage to secure rate." [source: https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/Las-Vegas-NV | verified: 2026-07-25]

Other conditions in that same disclaimer, current as of 2026-07-25: valid for new buyers only who sign a Sales Agreement for select quick move-in homes on or after 7/1/2026 and close by 8/31/2026; rate and APR based on a $714,286 purchase price, $500,000 loan amount, and 740 credit score; available for loan amounts between $250,000 and $832,750; minimum 30% down; primary residences only; excludes FHA and VA loans; not combinable with any other offer. [source: https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/Las-Vegas-NV | verified: 2026-07-25]

**upgrade_policy**
Toll Brothers Design Studios staffed by design consultants, plus "Designer Appointed Collections," which the company describes as nine curated interior designer collections for buyers who want pre-coordinated selections instead of picking item by item. [source: https://www.tollbrothers.com/faq | verified: 2026-07-25]

On financing upgrades, the only published statement found is about landscaping: the FAQ says that because landscape design is an enhancement and an investment in the home, a buyer may be able to build the cost into financing. [source: https://www.tollbrothers.com/faq | verified: 2026-07-25]

Published design-studio spend requirement or design credit amount: NOT FOUND. The design studio page is a stub that only links out to a separate Design Studio site. [source: https://www.tollbrothers.com/design-studio | verified: 2026-07-25]

**build_timeline**
"Building a home with Toll Brothers typically takes on average between 6-12 months," with the FAQ noting that timelines vary by region and community and that quick move-in homes are faster. [source: https://www.tollbrothers.com/faq | verified: 2026-07-25] Quick move-in inventory is sold: the Las Vegas page shows quick move-in counts by community, for example nine at Elkhorn Grove. [source: https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/Las-Vegas-NV | verified: 2026-07-25]

**price_band**
Clark County starting prices as published on 2026-07-25, base prices only: [source: https://www.tollbrothers.com/luxury-homes/Las-Vegas-NV | verified: 2026-07-25]

## 2. Blue Heron

**builder**
Blue Heron, a Las Vegas design-build firm established in 2004, operating a communities division (branded Nexus), a custom division (Blue Heron Elite), an interior design service (Atelier), and the Helix Collection of pre-designed homes built on a buyer's own lot. [source: https://blueheron.com/about/ | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://blueheron.com/communities/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

**warranty**
NOT FOUND. No warranty document, term lengths, or coverage tiers are published anywhere I checked. The about page, the communities page, the loan guide page, and the why-blue-heron page contain no warranty language at all. The only warranty statement found anywhere is a general marketing line on the Lake Las Vegas community page about warranty support and a Chief Client Experience Officer, with no terms attached. [source: https://blueheron.com/community/blue-heron-at-lake-las-vegas/ | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://blueheron.com/about/ | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://blueheron.com/why-blue-heron/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

**in_house_lender**
No affiliated or in-house mortgage company found. Blue Heron's published loan guide states: "Blue Heron has established strong relationships with various lenders to simplify the loan process for you." [source: https://blueheron.com/loan-guide/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

Incentives conditioned on a lender: NOT FOUND. No rate buydown, closing cost credit, or promotional financing offer of any kind is published on the Blue Heron site.

**upgrade_policy**
Not a design center model. Blue Heron pairs each buyer with an interior design expert who guides selection of wood, stone, tile, cabinetry, countertops, flooring, and hardware. The budget for design additions is estimated before the loan application. When selections are complete, the remaining deposit balance, described as community-specific, becomes due and the initial deposit is applied against it. [source: https://blueheron.com/loan-guide/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

Published design-center credit, spend requirement, or ability to finance upgrades: NOT FOUND. The loan guide implies design additions are folded into the purchase price budget, but no financing statement is published.

The Helix Collection is the fixed-package alternative: pre-engineered, pre-designed homes placed on the buyer's own lot, which Blue Heron says come with set pricing and delivery timelines. [source: https://blueheron.com/helix-collection/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

**build_timeline**
Contract to close: NOT FOUND. Two published milestones only:
- Construction begins approximately 4 to 6 weeks after the design phase is complete. [source: https://blueheron.com/loan-guide/ | verified: 2026-07-25]
- Sixty days before completion, Blue Heron works with the buyer and lender to finish closing documentation. [source: https://blueheron.com/loan-guide/ | verified: 2026-07-25]
- Pre-approval takes about three days per the same guide. [source: https://blueheron.com/loan-guide/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

Quick move-in or spec inventory: yes. The properties page lists homes marked "Move-In Ready," "Under Construction," "In Escrow," and "Exclusive Leaseback." [source: https://blueheron.com/properties/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

**price_band**
The communities page states homes start at $1.3 million and 2,800 square feet. [source: https://blueheron.com/communities/ | verified: 2026-07-25] Note that this conflicts with the Shoreline community page, which shows a lower starting price. Per-community starting prices as published 2026-07-25:

| Community | Location | Priced from | Sq ft |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shoreline | Lake Las Vegas, 42 Lakefront Way, Henderson | $1,031,000 | 2,750 to 3,659 |
| Stonewater | Southern Highlands, 4077 Heron Fairway Dr, Las Vegas | $1,314,000 | 2,750 to 3,659 |
| Velaris | Lake Las Vegas, 101 Still Shores St, Henderson | $1,438,000 | 2,870 to 4,688 |
| Liora | Lake Las Vegas, Henderson | $1,677,000 | 3,944 to 6,738 |
| Arvada | Lake Las Vegas, 101 Still Shores St, Henderson | $1,756,000 | 3,832 to 7,749 |
| Oasi | Tomiyasu neighborhood, 7070 Nomi Court, Las Vegas | $2,114,000 | 4,307 to 7,008 |
| Prado | West Las Vegas, 7388 Olive Creek Court, Las Vegas | $2,282,000 | 4,307 to 7,008 |
| The Canyon Residences at Ascaya | Henderson | $2,900,000 | 3,584 to 4,859 |

Sources: [https://blueheron.com/community/shoreline/ | verified: 2026-07-25], [https://blueheron.com/community/stonewater/ | verified: 2026-07-25], [https://blueheron.com/community/velaris/ | verified: 2026-07-25], [https://blueheron.com/community/liora/ | verified: 2026-07-25], [https://blueheron.com/community/arvada/ | verified: 2026-07-25], [https://blueheron.com/community/oasi/ | verified: 2026-07-25], [https://blueheron.com/community/prado/ | verified: 2026-07-25], [https://blueheron.com/community/canyon-at-ascaya/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

Custom division pricing is far higher. Listed custom homes on 2026-07-25 included Eterna at $20,000,000 (11,150 sq ft, Henderson) and Larae at $13,900,000 (9,350 sq ft, Henderson), both under construction. [source: https://blueheron.com/properties/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

Dated market context: on May 12, 2026 the Las Vegas Review-Journal reported Blue Heron bought about 26.6 acres at Lake Las Vegas in March 2026 for about $33.3 million, that Liora is planned for 60 lots with homes from about 3,900 to over 6,700 square feet starting at $1.6 million, and that a Blue Heron executive described Liora as the company's sixth community at Lake Las Vegas. [source: https://www.reviewjournal.com/business/luxury-builder-buys-land-for-33m-at-lake-las-vegas-unveils-new-waterfront-project-3822957/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

**clark_county_communities**
Eight active communities as of 2026-07-25: Liora, Arvada, Velaris, Shoreline (all Lake Las Vegas, Henderson), Stonewater (Southern Highlands, Las Vegas), Oasi (Tomiyasu neighborhood, Las Vegas), Prado (West Las Vegas), The Canyon Residences at Ascaya (Henderson). [source: https://blueheron.com/communities/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

Oasi is marked "Last Homesites Remaining" and every remaining homesite there now includes a private casita with covered patio. [source: https://blueheron.com/communities/ | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://blueheron.com/community/oasi/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

## 3. Christopher Homes

**builder**
Christopher Homes, founded by J. Christopher Stuhmer, headquartered at 648 Falcon Summit Court, Henderson, NV 89012. The company describes over 45 years of homebuilding experience. [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/neighborhoods | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/skyvu | verified: 2026-07-25]

**warranty**
NOT FOUND. The site has a "Warranty" navigation item and a "SUBMIT WARRANTY REQUEST" footer link pointing at /warranty-request, but no term lengths, tiers, or coverage description is published. The Customer Journey guide the company offers as a download mentions only that warranty documents are handed over at the new home orientation. Direct attempts at /warranty and /seneca both returned 404. [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/skyvu | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/sites/default/files/2023-08/CH23010_-_Customer_Journey_R6V1_JN.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]

**in_house_lender**
NOT FOUND. No affiliated mortgage company, no named preferred lender, and no financing incentive is published. The Customer Journey guide only notes that if the buyer is using a lender, Christopher Homes will help arrange a title appointment or mobile notary. [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/sites/default/files/2023-08/CH23010_-_Customer_Journey_R6V1_JN.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]

**upgrade_policy**
Three published collections rather than a single design center. [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/neighborhoods | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **Design-Build Custom Homes.** Buyer selects the homesite and plan type, chooses from 18 floorplans, and customizes all interior finishes.
- **Signature Custom Homes.** Construction has already started; the buyer can still personalize key design elements and finishes.
- **Furnished Custom Model Homes.** Available for a limited time, offering immediate move-in or a leaseback that provides rental income.

Published design-center spend requirement, credit, or ability to finance upgrades: NOT FOUND.

**build_timeline**
Contract to close: NOT FOUND. The Customer Journey guide publishes three checkpoints instead: a three-month completion window given at the foundation milestone, a two-month completion window given at the pre-drywall walkthrough, and pre-closing coordination beginning 60 days before delivery. [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/sites/default/files/2023-08/CH23010_-_Customer_Journey_R6V1_JN.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]

Quick move-in inventory: yes, marketed as Quick Move-In Homes and Furnished Custom Model Homes. [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/neighborhoods | verified: 2026-07-25]

**price_band**
Ultra luxury only. Design-Build Custom Homes are priced from $2.5 million to over $6 million; Signature Custom Homes are priced from the upper $3 millions. [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/neighborhoods | verified: 2026-07-25]

Published plan pricing at SkyVu as of 2026-07-25, lot cost included: [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/skyvu | verified: 2026-07-25]

| Residence | Levels | Priced from | Sq ft |
|---|---|---|---|
| Residence 4 | Two-level | $2,380,000 to $2,490,144 | 3,681 to 3,949 |
| Residence 6 | Three-level | $2,600,235 | 4,105 to 4,220 |
| Residence 3 | Single-level | $4,221,000 | 3,721 |
| Residence 2 | Two-level | $4,735,000 to $4,860,000 | 5,495 to 5,755 |
| Residence 3 | Two-level | $4,805,000 to $4,992,000 | 5,518 to 6,200 |

The SkyVu page also describes design-build floorplans ranging from 4,000 sq ft to over 6,300 sq ft. [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/skyvu | verified: 2026-07-25]

**clark_county_communities**
One. SkyVu at MacDonald Highlands, Henderson. Sales office 1797 MacDonald Ranch Drive, Henderson, NV 89012, tours by appointment only. MacDonald Highlands is 24-hour guard gated with the DragonRidge golf course. [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/neighborhoods | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/skyvu | verified: 2026-07-25]

The site navigation includes an item labeled "Seneca," which suggests a second community, but /seneca returns 404 and no Seneca content is published. Treat Seneca as unconfirmed. [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/skyvu | verified: 2026-07-25]

## 4. StoryBook Homes

**builder**
StoryBook Homes, Las Vegas. **This is a Toll Brothers company.** Toll Brothers announced the acquisition of StoryBook Homes on August 11, 2021; the founders and employees stayed and the communities continued to operate under the StoryBook brand as a Toll Brothers division. [source: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2021/08/11/2279254/1924/en/Toll-Brothers-Acquires-StoryBook-Homes-a-Privately-Held-Homebuilder-in-Las-Vegas.html | verified: 2026-07-25]

The current site confirms the relationship in operation, not just on paper: StoryBook plan pages name Toll Brothers Mortgage Company as the lender and route warranty to the Toll Brothers Homeowner Warranty Portal, and StoryBook community imagery is served from cdn.tollbrothers.com. Nevada broker license shown in the site footer is B.1003141.LLC. [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/Wellston-Ridge/Covena | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/search | verified: 2026-07-25]

This matters for the guide: a buyer walking into a StoryBook sales office is buying from Toll Brothers, with Toll Brothers financing and Toll Brothers warranty administration, at StoryBook price points.

**warranty**
StoryBook publishes no separate warranty terms. Its site links to a "Homeowner Warranty Portal," which resolves to the Toll Brothers homecare portal. [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/search | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/Wellston-Ridge/Covena | verified: 2026-07-25]

Because StoryBook is a Toll Brothers division and routes warranty through Toll Brothers, the governing document is presumably the Toll Brothers Limited Warranty described in Section 1 (one year materials and workmanship, two year systems, ten year structural, with 30 day notice requirement and binding arbitration). **Verify this at contract before printing it as fact for StoryBook specifically.** StoryBook-specific published warranty terms: NOT FOUND. [source: https://cdn.tollbrothers.com/pdfs/warranty_sc_toll.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]

**in_house_lender**
Toll Brothers Mortgage Company, NMLS #18154. [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/Wellston-Ridge/Covena | verified: 2026-07-25]

**Yes, the incentive is conditioned on using it.** StoryBook currently advertises a 3.99% (6.78% APR) first-year rate on an FHA 30 year fixed with a 2/1 buydown. The disclaimer states the rate and program are "available through Toll Brothers Mortgage Company NMLS #18154" and that "Buyer must complete a Rate Lock Agreement with Toll Brothers Mortgage to secure rate." [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

Other published conditions in that disclaimer, current as of 2026-07-25: valid for new buyers only who sign an Agreement of Sale on select quick delivery homes on or after 7/16/26 and close by 9/25/26; based on a $509,224 sales price and $491,401 base loan amount; minimum 660 credit score; FHA county conforming loan limits apply; not combinable with any other offer. The banner event carries an internal end date of 2026-10-29 and the disclaimer text is stamped 7/2026. [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

Note the split: the Toll Brothers branded incentive excludes FHA and VA loans and requires 30% down, while the StoryBook branded incentive is an FHA program with a 660 minimum score. Same lender, two different buyer profiles.

**upgrade_policy**
NOT FOUND. StoryBook publishes no design center policy, no options list, no spend requirement, and no upgrade financing statement. The site markets "designer appointed" quick move-in homes, meaning selections were already made by the builder. Some plan pages list what is already included, for example upgraded quartz kitchen countertops, 42 inch upper cabinets with crown molding, window coverings, garage door opener, and landscaped yard. [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

**build_timeline**
Contract to close for a to-be-built home: NOT FOUND. StoryBook sells quick move-in inventory with published delivery months; on 2026-07-25 the site showed homes with expected delivery in 7/2026, 8/2026, 9/2026, and 10/2026, with most inventory marked move-in ready. [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

**price_band**
Clark County starting prices as published 2026-07-25: [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/search | verified: 2026-07-25]

| Community | Type | Priced from | Sq ft | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Parkhill Crest | Townhome | $339,000 | 1,727+ | Quick move-in homes available |
| Wellston Ridge | Single family | $490,000 | 1,916+ | Quick move-in homes available |
| Ivyleaf Square | Single family | $545,000 | 2,429+ | Now open for sale |
| Brightridge | Single family | Not published | 2,494+ | Coming soon |

Band: roughly $339,000 to $545,000 as of 2026-07-25, townhomes and two-story single family. This is the most affordable product in this entire researcher's builder set aside from Touchstone Living and Harmony Homes.

Wellston Ridge specifics: sales center 4610 Saguaro Sunset Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89139; three two-story designs, 3 to 5 bedrooms; the community page states "No SIDS or LIDS," which is a meaningful cost fact for a Las Vegas buyer. [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/Wellston-Ridge | verified: 2026-07-25]

Dated company context: StoryBook announced the Wellston Ridge opening on April 10, 2026, describing three floor plans from 1,916 to 2,423 sq ft priced from the upper $400,000s, and describing itself as having 20 plus years in Southern Nevada. [source: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/04/10/3271907/0/en/StoryBook-Homes-Announces-Opening-of-Wellston-Ridge-Community-in-Las-Vegas.html | verified: 2026-07-25]

**clark_county_communities**
Three active plus one coming soon: Parkhill Crest, Wellston Ridge, Ivyleaf Square (all Las Vegas), and Brightridge (Las Vegas, coming soon). [source: https://www.storybooknewhomes.com/search | verified: 2026-07-25] A fifth community, Iron Pointe, is in Boulder City and was stripped from this list. See the excluded rows log.

## 5. Signature Homes

**builder**
Signature Homes, the trade name of Plaster Development Company, Inc., formed in 1978 by Richard and Wendy Plaster. The company states it has built over 13,000 homes, condominiums, and apartments. [source: https://signaturehomes.com/about-us/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

**warranty**
NOT FOUND. No warranty page, no term lengths, no coverage tiers anywhere on the site. I checked the home page, about page, communities index, the Signature Standards page, and all four community pages. [source: https://signaturehomes.com/ | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://signaturehomes.com/signature-standards/ | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://signaturehomes.com/about-us/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

**in_house_lender**
No in-house lender. The site disclaimer states flatly: "Signature Homes is not a lender and does not offer financing. Signature Homes makes no guarantees or representations regarding financing terms or the availability of any specific loan product." [source: https://signaturehomes.com/communities/royal-ridge-estates/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

**A preferred lender exists and the incentive runs through it, but the lender is not named on the site.** The Paradise Trails disclaimer states the illustrated payment is "based on an FHA loan scenario with a $27,500 down payment, a 740 FICO score, and an estimated 5.5 % interest rate available using the Paradise Trails Home Attainability Program and seller incentive for rate buydown at the time of calculation (July 9th, 2026), offered through Signature Homes' preferred lender." The published example structure is worth understanding before repeating the headline: the disclosure describes a primary mortgage with 5 monthly payments ranging from $460.13 to $467.46 followed by 355 monthly payments of $2,054.89 at 5.25% (6.155% APR), plus a separate down payment assistance loan with 120 monthly payments of $160.94 at 8% (8.157% APR). That second loan at 8% is the part a first-time buyer is most likely to miss. It belongs in the guide.

## Apparently inactive or unverifiable

### Brooks Homes: no verifiable active Clark County presence

I could not confirm that a homebuilder named Brooks Homes is actively selling new construction in Clark County as of 2026-07-25. Here is exactly what I checked and what came back.

- **No company website found.** Searches for "Brooks Homes Las Vegas Nevada homebuilder" and variants returned no builder site for a Las Vegas Brooks Homes. The domains that surfaced (brooksbuilthomes.com, brookshomesdsm.com, brooksbuildersgroup.com, brooksbuildersinc.com) are companies in other markets, not Las Vegas. [source: https://www.zillow.com/home-builders/las-vegas-nv/18959/ | verified: 2026-07-25]
- **The only Las Vegas hit is a Zillow builder profile stub.** Zillow lists "Brooks Home" as a small homebuilder with one Las Vegas community and buildable plans starting at a base price of $550,000. No community name, address, plan names, or contact details appear. Direct fetch of the Zillow builder profile returned HTTP 403, so I could not read past the search snippet. [source: https://www.zillow.com/home-builder-profile/brooks-home/19902/ | verified: 2026-07-25]
- **Not on any Las Vegas builder roundup checked.** Brooks does not appear on the allhomeslasvegas.com Las Vegas home builders list, which does carry Pinnacle Homes, Harmony Homes, Touchstone Living, and Signature Homes. [source: https://www.allhomeslasvegas.com/las-vegas/las-vegas-home-builders-list/ | verified: 2026-07-25]
- **Contractor licensing is ambiguous.** A search result describes "The Brooks Companies LLC" of Las Vegas as holding Nevada B2 residential and small commercial license 0088328 and notes the license status was at one point cancelled. I could not confirm this against the Nevada State Contractors Board directly because its license search runs behind a form. This may or may not be the same entity. [source: https://www.buildzoom.com/contractor/the-brooks-companies-llc | verified: 2026-07-25] [source: https://app.nvcontractorsboard.com/Clients/NVSCB/Public/ContractorLicenseSearch/ContractorLicenseSearch.aspx | verified: 2026-07-25]

**Recommendation:** leave Brooks Homes out of the guide entirely unless someone can produce a live sales office, a community, and a license number. The $550,000 Zillow figure is a single unsourced third-party data point and should not be printed.

### Builders in this set that are active but should carry a caveat

- **Harmony Homes.** Active as a company but its site publishes "Sales Office Hours Closed until further notice," carries a 2025 copyright, shows an empty listing grid, and publishes no prices. Confirm by phone (702-478-8375) before naming Harmony as a live option. [source: https://harmonyhomes.com/ | verified: 2026-07-25]
- **Edward Homes.** Only one for-sale Clark County community (Thrive @ Summerlin, 43 units) and its own page says only a handful of units remain. The same page still references a Q2 2025 delivery for an Arizona project, so it is at least partly stale. Everything else Edward Homes builds in Clark County is rental. [source: https://www.edwardhomesnv.com/neighborhoods | verified: 2026-07-25]
- **Landon Miller Homes.** Real and active, but it is a custom estate builder with no production communities, no base prices, and no sales office model. It does not belong in a side-by-side builder comparison table with Touchstone or StoryBook. [source: https://landonmillerhomes.com/ | verified: 2026-07-25]
- **Pinnacle Homes Aviara.** Down to two homes with the onsite sales center already closed. Likely to be sold out before the guide is published. [source: https://pinnaclelv.com/communities/aviara | verified: 2026-07-25]
- **Christopher Homes.** Active but down to a single published community (SkyVu). A navigation item labeled "Seneca" hints at a second project, but that page returns 404 and no content exists. [source: https://www.christopherhomes.com/skyvu | verified: 2026-07-25]

## Cross-builder observations for the guide writer

1. **Only one builder in this set publishes an actual warranty document.** Toll Brothers does, and by extension StoryBook Homes routes to it. Blue Heron, Christopher Homes, Signature Homes, Harmony Homes, Touchstone Living, Edward Homes, Trust Home Builders, Landon Miller Homes, and Pinnacle Homes all publish either nothing or a warranty request portal with no terms. The guide should tell buyers to demand the warranty document in writing before signing, and should not assume 1-2-10.

2. **Two of three builders with a published financing offer condition it on their own lender.** Toll Brothers and StoryBook require a Rate Lock Agreement with Toll Brothers Mortgage. Touchstone Living requires financing through its preferred lender **and** title company. Signature Homes routes its buydown through an unnamed preferred lender. Blue Heron, by contrast, publishes no incentive at all and says it works with various lenders.

3. **The incentive fine print is where the real terms live.** The Toll Brothers offer requires 30% down and excludes FHA and VA. The StoryBook offer is FHA with a 660 minimum score. Touchstone's "$0 down" includes a separate down payment assistance loan at 8% for 120 months. None of that is in the headline.

4. **Every advertised incentive in this set has a short fuse.** Toll Brothers: sign on or after 7/1/2026, close by 8/31/2026. StoryBook: sign on or after 7/16/26, close by 9/25/26. Signature's payment illustration is stamped July 9, 2026. Any figure copied into the guide will be stale within weeks. Describe the mechanism, not the number.

5. **The regional builders compete on standard features, not on options.** Touchstone ("Everything Included"), Signature ("Signature Standards," owned solar standard), and Trust ("generous standard features so upgrades are a choice") all lead with inclusions. Only Toll Brothers, Signature, and Trust reference a design center at all, and none of them publishes a spend requirement or a credit amount.

6. **Price ladder in this set as of 2026-07-25.** Touchstone Living from $307,990, StoryBook from $339,000, Signature Homes from $399,990, Toll Brothers from $449,995, Pinnacle inventory from $839,990, Blue Heron from $1,031,000, Christopher Homes from $2,380,000, Landon Miller from $3,400,000. Harmony Homes, Edward Homes (aside from a stale mid $500,000s figure), and Trust Home Builders publish nothing.
